narrative.overview: North Polar treats Discord as a continuous reading desk. Quiet indexes frame long conversations, while a compact native account dock and distinct voice connection stay close at hand. This records the North Polar implementation only; 125 Chromium assertions and the local finish review pass; native observations and limits are recorded in docs/MAINTENANCE.md.

rules.name: The Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep the reading page distinct from its supporting indexes; do not add decorative message cards.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Use surface tone and boundaries rather than ornamental elevation.

dos: Do preserve unread indicators, native labels and keyboard focus.
Do keep the notification bell native to retain mute state.
Do retain native custom profile identity outside the scoped decorative dock nameplate.
Do preserve shared reduced-motion behavior and the eight other themes.
donts: Don't paint generic layer containers or remove focus.
Don't present synthetic fixtures or historical concepts as real Discord validation.
Don't publish private conversations or screenshots.
